title: feat(fleet-write): pr_create carries labels; os-dev declares skip-changeset in the create's stroke
body:
Fixes #24157
Clause-②: no

## What this PR does

Two parts, one PR, the card's route 1 + 3 (fold `skip-changeset` into the `pr_create` stroke; rewrite the 「席位代做」 line). Option 4 (relaxing `Check Changeset`) is a gate change and is not here.

### 1. The relay op — `pr_create` carries `labels`

- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: `pr_create` gains an optional `labels` list. It becomes a later request of the SAME action, `POST /repos/REPO/issues/NUMBER/labels` with `fromAnswer: 'number'` and `labelled: [...a.labels]` — the exact shape the `assignees` leg has (`assigned`). The row still spends `pull-requests` with `alsoSpends: ['issues']`, so the token minted for the stroke already covers the labels POST; `PERMISSIONS` is unchanged and the workflow's mint step needed no edit.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`: the typed check is the one `labels_add` already uses — `FIELDS.labels` (array of 1..20 strings, each ≤ 50 bytes, no duplicates) is applied to any op whose key list admits `labels`, so adding `labels` to the row's `optional` is the whole validator change; the self-test gains the `pr_create` labels cases beside the assignees ones, the minimal-shape ledger names `labels`, and the 「exactly ONE descriptor reads an earlier answer」 pin becomes 「exactly TWO — assignees then labels」, with a new pin that every such leg is an additive POST to `/assignees` or `/labels`, never the whole-set replace.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` — **the one place that had to learn the leg** (the dispatch order assumed none): ① `requestLanded` judges a `labelled` descriptor's 2xx against the names sent — the labels endpoint answers the pull's whole label set, so a name it lacks is a FAILED action naming it, never a quiet partial; more than sent (the Auto Label workflow's `documentation` / `size/*`) is a landing. ② `resultOf` prints the labels as the platform lists them on that row. ③ `fromAnswer` legs are now filled from the action's FIRST answer (the create's), not the PREVIOUS request's: with both legs present the previous answer of the labels leg would have been the assignee POST's issue object, which happens to carry a number but is not the create. The self-test pins the label leg landing on the number the create answered while the assignee answer carries a different one.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` and `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` need nothing: dispatch's self-test is green unchanged (222 cases), and the workflow only runs `validate.mjs --from-env --github-output` then `execute.mjs`.

### 2. The dev contract — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, 404 → 404 lines (ceiling 404, headroom 0)

Four lines rewritten in place, no line added or removed. Each line's old text and where every dropped clause survives:

| line | before | after | dropped clause → survival |
|---|---|---|---|
| 61 | 写预算四笔:`git push`、`pr_create`(draft,含 assignee)、`label-write`(仅标签)、`os-dev-report` 评论 | 写预算三笔:`git push`、`pr_create`(draft,含 assignee 与 labels)、`os-dev-report` 评论 | `label-write`(仅标签) as a budgeted stroke → it is no longer a default stroke; the late-label case is named on line 303 |
| 303 | objectstack:标签是真实机制,打标签是你的默认步骤,PR 一开出就打;派发词可收窄或禁写 | objectstack:`skip-changeset` 以 `pr_create` 的 `labels` 同笔申报;后发现的标签才走 `label-write.mjs` | 「打标签是你的默认步骤,PR 一开出就打」→ strengthened: declared in the create's stroke, not after; 「标签是真实机制」→ the premise lines 306–307 rest on (a gate reads the label); 「派发词可收窄或禁写」→ line 304 verbatim: 范围 = 派发词点名的标签 + …;禁写或交集为空 ⇒ 零写并报告 |
| 305 | 写恒经 `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`:取现集、加法 POST、回读比 union、缺者重挂一次并报告 | 该腿的回读是中继回报的行:答案须列出每个送出的标签,缺者该笔 FAILED、不发后续动作 | the four steps are what `label-write.mjs` itself performs and prints on every invocation (its header: 「the four-step label write, as ONE spelling … Every invocation performs all four … re-added ONCE and REPORTED」), so the contract line was a mirror of the tool header, which AGENTS.md makes the authority; 「写恒经 scripts/pm/」→ line 55 (GitHub 写一律经 `scripts/pm/` 写工具) and line 303 names the tool for the late-label case |
| 309 | 分类器拒外部写 ⇒ 停手,`deviations` 记命令与拒因,席位代做;⛔ 不换路重发(curl/MCP/手工) | 分类器拒外部写 ⇒ 停手,`deviations` 记命令与拒因,席位只转维护者定夺;⛔ 不换路重发 | 「席位代做」→ replaced by design (the card's finding: the seat's harness forbids substituting for a refused action); 「(curl/MCP/手工)」→ line 308 「不走 MCP」, AGENTS.md 「⛔ Never a bare `curl` / `fetch` / `gh api -X POST…` write」, and 「不换路重发」 covers any manual route |

Lines 61 / 303 / 305 / 309 measure 104 / 118 / 119 / 117 bytes against the 120-byte line budget. No re-wrap, no merge, no ceiling raise.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **(a) confirmed** at the base `bd4276a91` (origin/main had advanced from the order's `697301491` when the worktree was cut): `pr_create` had `optional: ['body', 'assignees']` only; the filer's 「the relay's `pr_create` op takes `labels`」 was false, so option 1 needed the op leg.
- **(b) stands, and nothing here can prove more:** the classifier refusal was measured once (PR #24153 refused, PR #24139 allowed, identical `label-write.mjs` command). This PR cannot show the classifier will accept a `pr_create` carrying `labels`; the measured fact is that the `pr_create` stroke has not been refused since the assignee precedent #22467. This PR's own `skip-changeset` had to go the OLD way (`label-write.mjs`) because a PR cannot use the leg it introduces.
- **(c) confirmed:** `pr-automation.yml` writes `size/*` and the path labels by additive POST (the `Auto Label` and `Check PR Size` jobs), so the two never overwrite each other. `Check Changeset` reads the label live (a re-read plus a settling read, because the frozen `opened` payload cannot see a label applied after creation; its own comment measures label latency at 10–45 s after creation). The leg lands inside the relay's own stroke, seconds after the create, so it falls inside that settling window — and the `labeled` event re-triggers the job in any case.
- **(d) run** — see Verification. **(e) read** the current lines (the card's quotation of line 61 and the labels block matched the tree at the base).
- **Falsified:** 「read `execute.mjs` … to confirm nothing else must learn the new leg」 — it did: without `labelled` the executor would have passed a 200 whose answer lacks the label (ablation B, below, shows exactly that quiet partial), and the fill source had to move from the previous answer to the create's (ablation A).

## Verification (final commit `f9e63d6c3`)

Relay self-tests (rule ⑤ — the edited scripts' own suites; no `*.test.*` file names them):

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 158 cases / 11 batteries (was 152).
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 128 cases / 16 batteries (was 120; the assignees-leg battery is re-declared in `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` as the assignees-and-labels battery, pin 11 → 19).
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 222 cases / 20 batteries (unchanged).
- `ops.mjs` has no `--self-test` of its own (its pins live in the validate and execute suites).

Ablations — each via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit ×1, blob changed, command run, restore proven by blob == HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` empty; no `dist/` is involved, these are plain node scripts):

- **A** `execute.mjs`: `if (opener === null) opener = r;` → `opener = r;` (back to previous-answer fill). Expected red; observed 2 of 128 red — 「at the number the CREATE answered, not the assignee answer's」 and the row-text case. Blob `f246498…` → `af59de9…` → restored `f246498…`.
- **B** `execute.mjs`: `const missing = req.labelled.filter(` → `const missing = [].filter(`. Expected red; observed 1 of 128 red — 「a 200 whose answer lacks a name sent is a FAILED action … never a quiet partial」 (the run passed with exit 0 and 3 writes under the mutation: the quiet partial). Blob `f246498…` → `69e1572…` → restored `f246498…`.
- **C** `ops.mjs`: `optional: ['body', 'assignees', 'labels']` → `['body', 'assignees']`. Expected red; observed 6 of 158 validator cases red (the labels acceptance cases, the minimal-shape ledger, the two-descriptor pin). Blob `6ad2cb6…` → `83deec1…` → restored `6ad2cb6…`.

Gates — derived at `f9e63d6c3` with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; 48 families, the path-named derivation at the base plus `check:pm-write-pace`, which names `execute.mjs`). Every command run in the foreground with its exit code captured before any pipe: all 48 exit 0. One of them, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` build in the fresh worktree — a non-measurement, not counted); after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` behind `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0) it re-ran to exit 0. Reconciled with `--ran`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → exit 0, 「48 derived, 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN」, every family carrying a recorded exit code. The five families the order named (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:agent-model-declared`, `check:pm-settings-deny-roster`) are each exit 0. Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, `test:repo`) are CI's; the PR's check-runs are the authority for every family CI runs.

## Acceptance notes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` line 22 still tells the seat 「dev 挂 `skip-changeset` 遭分类器拒 ⇒ 席位自核 tests/docs-only 即自挂」 — the seat-side twin of the line this PR rewrites, outside this card's file surface. Reported in the dev report for the seat; not changed here.
- `dispatch.mjs`'s seat-side read-back (`assigneesReading`) has no labels twin; the relay row (`execute.mjs`) is the read-back line 305 now names. Observation only, nothing filed.
- Governed surface, Tier S (`.claude/**`): this PR stays draft and awaits a `## Contract review` record; `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` publish nothing → `skip-changeset`, applied the old way (reported in the dev report with endpoint and status if refused).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:中继的 `pr_create` 操作新增可选 `labels`,开 PR 的同一笔里顺手贴标签(和已有的 assignee 腿同一形状);执行器只认「答案里列出了每个送出的标签」才算落地,缺一个就报 FAILED 停下。`os-dev.md` 四行原地改写:写预算四笔变三笔;`skip-changeset` 在开 PR 那一笔申报,事后才发现的标签才用 `label-write.mjs`;分类器拒写时席位只转维护者定夺、不代做。行数 404 → 404,未抬上限。

**为什么改**:同一条 `label-write` 命令,一次放行一次被拒(PR #24139 / PR #24153),被拒后原文让「席位代做」,而席位的 harness 把替子代理补做被拒动作视为洗权限,于是每次被拒都变成一次向您提问。把标签并入从未被拒的 `pr_create` 一笔,是 #22467 处理 assignee 时走过的同一条路。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:不能证明分类器一定放行带 `labels` 的 `pr_create`,只能说该笔自 #22467 以来未被拒过。本 PR 自身的 `skip-changeset` 仍按旧路贴(新腿要合并后才可用)。回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个 commit;中继无状态,不影响已开 PR。

**席位意见**:(留空,席位定稿)

**你要做的**:本 PR 触及 `.claude/**`(Tier S),由席位做达档复核后入队落地,无需您点击;如希望顺手也改 `review-checklist.md` 第 22 行的席位侧措辞,请一句话说明,席位另立卡。
